novel.title: The World Turned into a Game After I Woke Up
novel.summary: On July 17, 2023, a divine being called the Scientist announces that Earth has completed its test and will enter the Otadolon stage. Eleven years later in 2034, Lee Jiwon throws himself into the Sea of Reset and wakes up on July 17, 2022, one year before the world changed. Armed with eleven years of future knowledge, he races to become Earth's first deva, battles the Seven Monarchs, protects the Werewolf Clan, defeats the Reaper in the UAE, survives a Dungeon Maker's prison trap, and leads humanity through the Judge's Continent stage before applying for a job at the Sunbin Group.

characters.name: Lee Jiwon
characters.description: Average Korean male in his thirties. Orphan background. Carries himself with quiet, overwhelming confidence that belies his humble appearance.
characters.personality: Calculating, disciplined, driven by greed repurposed as motivation. Sarcastic. Deeply practical. Loves food excessively.
characters.background: Grew up in an orphanage, went to high school, then served in the army as a sergeant. Became a fire mage and reached level 576 in the original timeline before being wronged by Lee Gangchan and jumping into the Sea of Reset.
characters.current_power_level: Level 690+ at end of Otadolon stage

power_progression.stage: Level 0 - Earth's First Deva, 1220 all stats
Level 200 - Moved to new hunting ground

characters.name: Song Haein
characters.description: Granddaughter of Song Daechul, chairman of the Sunbin Group.
characters.background: Grew up in the Sunbin Group dynasty. Overshadows her brother Song Haechang.

characters.name: Song Daechul
characters.description: Patriarch of the Song family and chairman of the Sunbin Group.
characters.personality: Pragmatic, authoritative, calculating but not without warmth.
characters.background: Built the Sunbin Group into the dominant power of Seoul. Secured humanity's survival in Seoul-Incheon-Gyeonggi.

characters.name: Song Haechang
characters.description: Son of Song Myungsoo. In original timeline was charismatic and respected. In current timeline has deteriorated into an unstable wreck due to inferiority complex.
characters.personality: In past timeline: charismatic and proud. In current timeline: consumed by jealousy and self-loathing.
characters.background: Orchestrated Lee Jiwon's kidnapping by the Hitman Guild.
characters.current_power_level: First Unrivaled deva of the Sunbin Guild

characters.name: Song Myungsoo
characters.description: Son of Song Daechul. Senior member of the Sunbin Guild leadership.
characters.background: Second generation of the Sunbin dynasty.

characters.name: Lee Gangchan
characters.description: The deva who wronged Lee Jiwon in the original timeline, killing him over one hundred times.
characters.background: Referenced throughout as Jiwon's ultimate revenge target.

characters.name: Anton
characters.description: Manager of Store 72. Grumpy and profit-minded.
characters.background: Manages one of the 108 stores serving Earth's devas.

characters.name: Sleng
characters.description: Employee at Store 72.
characters.background: Works under Anton.

characters.name: Oh Taeshik
characters.description: Leader of the Hitman Guild. Song Haechang's inside man.
characters.background: Ordered to kidnap Lee Jiwon. Lee Jiwon extorted 47 million golden rings from him.

characters.name: Shin
characters.description: Guild master of the Myth Guild, Cairo, Egypt.
characters.background: Leader of Egypt's Myth Guild. Long conflict with the Blood Prince's Federation.
characters.current_power_level: High-level deva, strongest of the Myth Guild

characters.name: Ebonene
characters.description: Senior officer of the Myth Guild. Believes greatness requires equal parts skill and luck.
characters.background: One of the Myth Guild's top officers.

characters.name: Edwifu
characters.description: Officer of the Myth Guild.
characters.background: Senior member of the Myth Guild's command staff.

characters.name: Blood Prince
characters.description: One of the Seven Monarchs. Deity known for blood-based abilities. Warred against the Myth Guild in Egypt. Conducted the Blood Purge in the original timeline.
characters.background: One of the Seven Monarchs. Disrupted in the current timeline by Lee Jiwon.

characters.name: Fayez
characters.description: One of the Seven Monarchs, known as the Reaper. Commands death-type abilities. Activated a Target skill against Lee Jiwon cancelling Unrivaled.
characters.personality: Mocking and confident. Underestimates Lee Jiwon until too late.
characters.background: Defeated when Jiwon used Predation of Shaman Ko to multiply stats twentyfold.

characters.name: Predator Duke
characters.description: One of the Seven Monarchs. Enormous obese deity approximately ten meters tall. Absorbs abilities of everyone he consumes.
characters.personality: Gluttonous and singularly focused on consuming the strong.
characters.background: Targeted the Werewolf Clan. Defeated when Lee Jiwon intervened.

characters.name: Kazunari
characters.description: Japanese deity, one of the Seven Monarchs. Creates new dungeons using a Dungeon Mole.
characters.background: Created a prison dungeon trap for Lee Jiwon. The scheme failed.

characters.name: Zulova
characters.description: Deity-class individual. Became Lee Jiwon's involuntary ally via the Call register system.
characters.personality: Proud and initially hostile. Reluctantly cooperative.
characters.background: Subject to Jiwon's extortion scheme.

characters.name: Kylie van Agassi
characters.age: nineteen at time of becoming a deva
characters.description: Daughter of Werewolf Clan head Lodin Schutt van Agassi. Part human, part werewolf.
characters.background: Became a deva at nineteen then accepted irreversible werewolf transformation. Sent to find Lee Jiwon as last hope.

characters.name: Lodin Schutt van Agassi
characters.description: Head of the Werewolf Clan, based in the Faroe Islands.
characters.background: Cursed his lineage into werewolf form. Had 800-year network of connections that all refused to help.

characters.name: Daniel Miller
characters.description: Guild master of the Shire Group, America's richest and most powerful guild.
characters.background: Invited Lee Jiwon to help clear the 27th high-grade dungeon. Core pillar of the Empire coalition.

characters.name: Arthur Lucas
characters.description: Son of Victor Lucas. Enormously powerful deva who uses the House Centipede pay-to-win system.
characters.background: Challenged Lee Jiwon solo to test his heroic credentials. Thoroughly beaten but becomes an ally.
characters.current_power_level: Stronger than any of the Seven Monarchs at peak

characters.name: Victor Lucas
characters.description: Guild master of the Messenger Guild, the world's wealthiest guild running all Teleporters globally.
characters.background: Aligned with the Empire when news of the Judge's Continent spread.

characters.name: Wai Chung
characters.description: Guild master of the Cheng Long Guild, China's most powerful guild.
characters.background: Conspired with Kazunari and Okamoto to create a prison dungeon for Lee Jiwon.

characters.name: Okamoto
characters.description: Guild master of the Nayuta Guild, Japan's foremost deva organisation.
characters.background: Aligned with Wai Chung and Kazunari against Sunbin and Lee Jiwon.

characters.name: Baden al Nayan
characters.description: Guild master of Abu Dhabi's deva organisation and head of the UAE royal family.
characters.background: Leads Abu Dhabi against the Reaper. Provided Lee Jiwon a letter of recommendation.

characters.name: Umaru
characters.description: Senior officer under Baden al Nayan.
characters.background: Executed the order to send 500 elite soldiers to support Lee Jiwon during the Reaper battle.

characters.name: Claudia
characters.description: The strongest Crootian deity. Has the exclusive ability to steal time from others.
characters.background: Controls the Crootian High Council. Froze Dunia in statue form for five years.

characters.name: Dunia
characters.description: A scheming Crootian figure with red and black alternating pupils. Has vague information-gathering ability blocked entirely when aimed at Lee Jiwon.
characters.personality: Playful, self-serving, treats everyone with barely-disguised contempt.
characters.background: Frozen in statue form for five years by Claudia. Revived and deployed as spy.
special_abilities: Red Eyes - seed deep trust in targets

characters.name: Coby
characters.description: Crootian officer serving under Claudia.
characters.background: Relays information to Claudia during council meetings.

characters.name: Shaman Ko
characters.age: appears approximately five to six years old
characters.description: A mysterious young child who manifests physically only at Lee Jiwon's most desperate moments. Has a Dungeon Mole tied to his hip.
characters.personality: Appears childlike and innocent. Speaks very rarely.
characters.background: Tied to the Shaman Ko's Selfish Prick skill. Manifested to consume the Predator Duke's Predation ability. Consumed by Lee Jiwon during the Reaper battle.
special_abilities: Shaman Ko's Will - hundredfold STR boost for 3 seconds
Enables consumption of Predation from defeated targets
Daily stat roulette always landing on 3

characters.name: Samuel
characters.description: Officer of the Shire Guild who leads the party clearing the 27th high-grade dungeon. Calls Lee Jiwon captain.
characters.background: Ensured all 20 random chests went to Lee Jiwon.

characters.name: Jacob
characters.description: Enthusiastic member of the Shire Guild party.
characters.background: Participated in the Dark Caster dungeon raid.

characters.name: Devram
characters.description: Mage member of the Shire Guild party who received the Rank 7 gloves and Rank 6 ring from the Dark Caster drop.
characters.background: Participated in the 27th high-grade dungeon raid.

characters.name: Black Clawed Panther
characters.description: Mankind's first deva in the original timeline. Famous for twin swords and twelve types of poison. Deliberately spread false rumours about first deva bonuses.
characters.background: In current timeline, Lee Jiwon beats him to the Don Gate.
special_abilities: Twelve types of poison including cursing, neurotoxin, paralytic, and bleeding

characters.name: Park Manho
characters.description: Board member of the Sunbin Guild.
characters.background: Part of Song Daechul's inner circle.

characters.name: Kim Jongmin
characters.description: HR team member at the Sunbin Group. In the final arc discovers authentic letters from world leaders in Lee Jiwon's application.
characters.background: Mid-level HR staff at Sunbin Group.

characters.name: Choi Kyungman
characters.description: Wealthy interviewee number 114 at Sunbin Group's interview day, seated next to Lee Jiwon.
characters.background: Secretly investigates Lee Jiwon during the interview wait.

characters.name: Sunghoon
characters.description: Leader of Assault Team 1 of the Myth Guild.
characters.personality: Honest and awestruck by Lee Jiwon's abilities.
characters.background: Commands one of the Myth Guild's primary assault teams.

characters.name: Arman Lagus
characters.description: Original timeline figure who led liberation forces freeing dungeons from large guild control.
characters.background: In original timeline, rose from humble origins to lead a major underground movement.

characters.name: Madun Yatekin
characters.description: Original timeline figure who led a mercenary force of twenty-five thousand devas.
characters.background: Commanded a large mercenary army in the original timeline.

characters.name: Oh Hyungjae
characters.description: Encountered by Lee Jiwon during his early hunting period.
characters.background: Met Lee Jiwon during the dungeon-seeking phase.

characters.name: Kim Sungryul
characters.description: Song Haein's private assistant for ten years.
characters.background: Tracked Lee Jiwon's movements and reported back to Song Haein.

power_system.name: Otadolon System - Deva / Deity Progression
power_system.description: On July 17, 2023, a being humans call the Scientist transformed Earth into the Otadolon stage. Every human received a token of knowledge on their wrist. Adults aged 19 or older could use the token at a Don Gate to undergo deva transformation. Every level-up grants 10 bonus stat points (20 for Unrivaled users). Skills cost skill points gained 1 per 50 levels. Death incurs a 2-point penalty to all five stats. After Otadolon completes, the world transitions to the Judge's Continent.

tiers.name: Mortal
tiers.description: Ordinary human who has not used their token at a Don Gate.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Use token of knowledge at a Don Gate aged 19 or older

tiers.name: Deva
tiers.description: Immortal game-avatar body. Gains stat menu, skill tree, inventory, level system, and resurrection on death with stat penalties.

tiers.name: Deity
tiers.description: Superior class above devas. Not gained through normal progression. Cannot gain EXP from killing devas.
tiers.breakthrough_requirements: Unknown - appears to be a chosen status

special_constitutions.name: Unrivaled
special_constitutions.description: A passive skill costing 20 skill points, hidden in Store 72's general skill tab. Grants status immunity, reduces deity damage by 50%, and doubles stat gain per level-up to 20 points.
disadvantages: Costs 20 skill points leaving almost none for other skills
special_constitutions.lore: Discovered at Store 72 by Lee Jiwon using his future knowledge.

daos_or_paths.name: Blood Path
daos_or_paths.description: The Blood Prince's deity path. Commands blood in multiple forms.

daos_or_paths.name: Death Path
daos_or_paths.description: The Reaper's deity path. Commands death as a weapon and field effect.

daos_or_paths.name: Predation Path
daos_or_paths.description: The Predator Duke's deity path. Consumes others to absorb abilities.

daos_or_paths.name: Dungeon Creation Path
daos_or_paths.description: Kazunari's exclusive deity ability. Creates new dungeons using a Dungeon Mole.

daos_or_paths.name: Time Manipulation Path
daos_or_paths.description: Claudia's exclusive deity ability. Steals time from others.

regression_loops.trigger: Lee Jiwon jumps into the Sea of Reset on April 15, 2034 after being wronged and killed over 100 times by Lee Gangchan
key_changes: Woke up on July 17, 2022 - one year before the world changed
Retained all memories of 11 years of future knowledge
Became Earth's First Deva receiving 200 bonus stat points and 10 extra skill points
Chose Luck Boost from the Fastest Deva event
Changed from fire mage to spearman melee class
Blood Prince's Blood Purge in Egypt was prevented
Predator Duke was stopped before enslaving the Werewolf Clan
Reaper was defeated in the UAE
regression_loops.outcome: Lee Jiwon creates a dramatically superior timeline, becoming the strongest deva on Earth

techniques.name: Unrivaled
techniques.rank_required: Level 0 for Lee Jiwon; Level 500 for others
techniques.description: Passive skill purchased at Store 72 for 20 skill points. Grants complete status immunity, halves all damage from deities, doubles stat point gain per level-up.
techniques.lore: Hidden in the general skill tab of Store 72.

techniques.name: Shaman Ko's Selfish Prick
techniques.description: 1 skill point passive. Daily roulette that always lands on 3 stat points. Can evolve into Shaman Ko's Will.
effects: Shaman Ko's Will: hundredfold STR boost for 3 seconds
Can manifest as physical child enabling Predation consumption
techniques.lore: Physical manifestation is a scruffy child of around five years.

techniques.name: Warrior's Brave Spirit
techniques.description: 2 skill point active skill. Raises ATT, CRIT, movement speed. 8-hour cooldown, 1-hour duration.
effects: ATT +20%, CRIT chance +1%, CRIT damage +50%, movement speed +5%, attack speed +2.5%
Fatigue does not rise while active
techniques.lore: Considered one of the best fighter class skills.

techniques.name: Mana Conversion
techniques.description: 3 skill point skill converting mana type. Fire mode effective against undead.
effects: Converts mana type to chosen element
Fire conversion increases damage against undead
techniques.lore: A well-rounded skill known to most devas.

techniques.name: Judge's Gavel
techniques.description: 3 skill point active skill. Next attack always critical hit with massive bonuses. 3600-second cooldown. Costs only 1 golden ring.
effects: Level 3: +10000 base damage, next attack +500% damage, +1000% CRIT damage
techniques.origin: Store skill purchase - requires special prerequisites
techniques.lore: Sent the Reaper flying ten meters back.

techniques.name: Blink
techniques.description: Short-range teleport skill. Level 2 (Blink 2) is an upgraded version.
techniques.lore: Used sparingly as a trump card.

techniques.name: Fissure
techniques.description: AoE ground attack sending a shockwave across an area.
techniques.lore: Used during the Arthur Lucas fight.

techniques.name: Howl of the Wolf
techniques.description: Activation buff skill obtained during the werewolf clan arc.
effects: Grants a combat buff on activation
techniques.lore: Associated with the werewolf clan encounter.

techniques.name: Altered Equality
techniques.description: Equalises Lee Jiwon's stats with a target opponent.
techniques.lore: Used against Arthur Lucas and the Reaper.

techniques.name: Predation
techniques.description: Originally the Predator Duke's exclusive deity ability. Consuming a target allows use of their abilities for 24 hours.
effects: Consume a valid target and use their abilities for 24 hours
When used on Shaman Ko Effect 2: all non-Shaman-Ko stats x10
After 24 hours all stolen abilities return
weaknesses: Can only be used on certain targets
techniques.origin: Extracted from Predator Duke via Shaman Ko
techniques.lore: Used on Shaman Ko (Effect 2) during the Reaper battle.

techniques.name: Heel Kick
techniques.description: Active melee kick skill. Deleted at level 450 to free up a skill point for Judge's Gavel.

techniques.name: Blood Explosion
techniques.description: The Blood Prince's blood bomb skill. Doubles in size under Blood Rush.
effects: Size and damage double under Blood Rush

techniques.name: Blood Rush
techniques.description: The Blood Prince's power boost mode. Doubles all blood skills.

techniques.name: Touch of Death
techniques.description: The Reaper's passive aura debuff. Within 150 meters, ATT/MATT/DEF/MDEF reduced by 30%, recovery skills lose 90%.
techniques.lore: Even Baden's soldiers had abilities near-halved just by approaching the duel.

techniques.name: Wall of Death
techniques.description: The Reaper's defensive barrier skill. Multiple layers can be maintained simultaneously.
weaknesses: Overwhelming volume can breach the first layer

techniques.name: House Centipede
techniques.description: Arthur Lucas's unique system. Spend golden rings to boost ATT, DEF, and SKILL power with each use. Per-attack boost capped at 3 million golden rings (300% boost).
effects: Spend golden rings to boost ATT/DEF/SKILL power
Combat Mode activation up to 100 million golden rings
Per-attack boost capped at 3 million golden rings
techniques.lore: Arthur spent over 400 million golden rings and still lost.

techniques.name: Petrifying Glare
techniques.description: Gorgon ability attempting to inflict Petrification. Blocked completely by Lee Jiwon's Unrivaled status immunity.

artifacts.name: Orc Champion's Armor
artifacts.description: Crude armor worn by an orc champion.
artifacts.origin: Dropped by Orc Champion in Bukhansan dungeon
artifacts.lore: First piece of armor Lee Jiwon obtained.

artifacts.name: Orc Champion's Unexpectedly Strong Greatsword
artifacts.description: Greatsword wielded by the Orc Champion. Forged with poor materials but came out better than expected.
artifacts.origin: Dropped by Orc Champion in Bukhansan dungeon
artifacts.lore: The Penetration +47 was noted as being worth Rank 4-5 value.

artifacts.name: Medusa's Cursed Earrings
artifacts.description: Medusa's soul imprisoned in earrings. Increases Gorgon Petrification chance but grants bonus EXP from killing Gorgons.
abilities: Chance to be cursed by Gorgon Petrify +28%
artifacts.origin: Dropped by Gorgons in Pocheon hunting grounds
artifacts.lore: Worst-in-slot for Gorgon hunting for everyone else, but valuable to Lee Jiwon for the 9% EXP bonus.

artifacts.name: Damage Link Totem
artifacts.description: One of the Link Totems. Transfers a portion of damage received to the Totem.
abilities: Absorbs 5-9% of damage received (upgraded to 9% using 4 million golden rings)
artifacts.origin: Obtained by Lee Jiwon prior to Blood Prince battle

artifacts.name: Lush Greenery of the Great Forest
artifacts.description: A master craftsman spent his entire life in Cagil Forest crafting this cuirass from its lumber and coals.
abilities: When HP drops by 10%, DEF and MDEF doubled for 10 seconds
artifacts.origin: Obtained from a dungeon in Egypt
artifacts.lore: One of Lee Jiwon's core defensive pieces.

artifacts.name: King-Emperor's Commitment
artifacts.description: An item with an aura called Grand King-Emperor's Dignity that debuffs all enemies within range by reducing all stats by 12%.
abilities: Grand King-Emperor's Dignity aura: enemy all stats -12%
artifacts.lore: Noticed by Myth Guild soldiers when their attacks cut through previously impenetrable Croc armour.

artifacts.name: Bracelet of Eternal Fire
artifacts.description: Prevents the wearer from dying outright. Last Breath activates when HP reaches 0, restoring 35% of total HP. Deactivated for 30 days after triggering.
abilities: Last Breath: when HP reaches 0, restores 35% of total HP
artifacts.origin: Obtained before the Predator Duke battle
artifacts.lore: Saved Lee Jiwon's life in the Blood Prince battle, Predator Duke battle, and Reaper battle.

artifacts.name: Dark Crystal
artifacts.description: Holds the entire essence of the Dark Caster. Crushed over another item to grant one of two effects with a 1% chance each.
abilities: Effect 1: 1% chance to upgrade one of the chosen item's effects by one tier
Effect 2: 1% chance to grant Darkness effect
artifacts.origin: 20th random chest from the 27th high-grade dungeon boss clear
artifacts.lore: Lee Jiwon planned to use it alongside his Random Skill Chest for a luck-stacking effect.

artifacts.name: Death's Harrier
artifacts.description: A spear with HP Absorb that restores 1000 HP per successful hit.
abilities: HP Absorb: restores 1000 HP per hit
artifacts.lore: Lee Jiwon noted its effectiveness would eventually drop off.

artifacts.name: Dungeon Mole
artifacts.description: A small shaggy creature that Kazunari uses to create new dungeons. Also appears tied to Shaman Ko's hip.
abilities: Enables creation of new dungeons for Kazunari

artifacts.name: Indomitable Nature
artifacts.description: Arthur Lucas's shield. Even with 700% DEF boost still took 15 million damage from Lee Jiwon's critical hits.
artifacts.lore: With 700% DEF boost Arthur still took 15 million damage from Lee Jiwon's critical hits.

pills_and_resources.name: Token of Knowledge
effects: Enables deva transformation when used at a Don Gate
Cannot be stolen, lost, or transferred
ingredients: Given by the Scientist upon world change

pills_and_resources.name: Golden Rings
effects: Can be spent by Arthur Lucas to boost combat abilities
ingredients: Found in dungeons and random chests

pills_and_resources.name: Shining Health Potion
effects: Restores a significant amount of HP

pills_and_resources.name: Death Penalty Restoration Gem
effects: Restores stat points lost to the death penalty
ingredients: Found in random dungeon chests at low spawn rate

pills_and_resources.name: Warp Scroll
effects: Teleports user out of a dungeon
Cannot be used inside Kazunari's prison dungeon

pills_and_resources.name: Rank 3 Dust
effects: Used in crafting to increase chance of creating Rank 4 items

pills_and_resources.name: Bread and Drink
effects: Basic sustenance for devas during extended dungeon stays

bloodlines.name: Van Agassi Werewolf Bloodline
bloodlines.origin: The Werewolf Clan head Lodin Schutt van Agassi cursed his family line approximately 800 years ago. Devas in the clan can choose irreversible werewolf transformation upon becoming devas.

abilities: Yields EXP and items equal to elite monsters when killed
Forced resurrection in Faroe Islands homeland

bloodlines.lore: The werewolf transformation was an extreme trade. The forced resurrection made them a perfect infinite food source for the Predator Duke.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Orc
beasts_and_creatures.description: Green-skinned humanoid monsters. Common in low-grade dungeons.
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Among the first monsters to appear after the world changed.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Legendary Red Orc Champion
beasts_and_creatures.description: Over three meters tall with bulging muscles and spiky red hair. Wields a giant blade.
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Recommended party of at least 4. Lee Jiwon solo'd it at level 15. First boss ever killed in the current timeline.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Gorgon
beasts_and_creatures.description: Medusa-type snake-haired monsters. Use Petrifying Glare, summon snakes, and fire Lightning spells.
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Lee Jiwon hunted them for two full weeks, gaining 100 levels.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Giant Spider
beasts_and_creatures.description: 1.5 meter tall spiders with eight eyes. Lack venom or webbing. Smart enough to retreat when outmatched.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Mutated Crocodile (Croc)
beasts_and_creatures.description: Large crocodile monsters with razor-sharp tails and armored hide too thick for normal attacks.
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Lee Jiwon's King-Emperor's Commitment debuffed their stats by 12%, allowing Myth Guild soldiers to cut through their previously impenetrable hides.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Dark Caster
beasts_and_creatures.description: Lich King-like boss with a fail-safe mechanism: when HP hits 0, HP regenerates unless a hidden Dark Crystal inside its body is destroyed first.

named_individuals.name: Dark Crystal fail-safe mechanism
named_individuals.notes: Lee Jiwon identified the hidden Dark Crystal that must be destroyed to permanently kill the boss

beasts_and_creatures.lore: Lee Jiwon discovered the fail-safe and directed the party to destroy the hidden Dark Crystal.

beasts_and_creatures.name: Ogre
beasts_and_creatures.description: Three-meter tall humanoid monsters with massive clubs on the Judge's Continent.
abilities: Increased reaction speed over time during Survival event
beasts_and_creatures.lore: Lee Jiwon entered an empty Ogre Dungeon and triggered the Survival special event, spending over 30 days inside.

locations.name: Earth / World 1455
locations.description: The protagonist's home world. Entered the Otadolon stage on July 17, 2023.
locations.lore: Called World 1455 by the Scientist. After Otadolon completes, transitions to the Judge's Continent stage.

locations.name: Bukhansan Mountain Dungeon
locations.description: Low-grade dungeon 47, located on Bukhansan Mountain near Seoul. Three floors.
locations.lore: First dungeon discovered and first boss defeated in the current timeline by Lee Jiwon.

locations.name: Store 72
locations.description: One of 108 game-world shops serving Earth's devas. Sells skills, items, and hosts an auction house. Managed by Anton.
locations.lore: The Unrivaled skill was hidden in Store 72's general skill catalogue.

locations.name: Pocheon Hunting Grounds
locations.description: Area near Pocheon city north of Seoul. Home to Gorgon populations.
dangers: Gorgons - Petrifying Glare, Lightning, snake summons
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon hunted here for two full weeks, gaining 100 levels.

locations.name: Sunbin Guild Headquarters
locations.description: A 97-story building in Seoul. Houses guild command, Song Daechul's chairman suite on the 96th floor.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon visited here twice.

locations.name: Myth Guild Headquarters, Cairo
locations.description: Operational and strategic centre of the Myth Guild in Cairo, Egypt.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon stayed here for over three months during his dungeon-grinding phase.

locations.name: Khufu's Pyramid Dungeon
locations.description: Mid-grade dungeon in Egypt, full of undead monsters weak against Fire.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon hunted here for three months, gaining 95 levels from level 355 to 450.

locations.name: Pharos Dungeon, Alexandria
locations.description: High-grade dungeon in Alexandria, Egypt. Controlled by the Myth Guild. Home to Crocodile monsters.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon was given permission despite being below the recommended level 700+.

locations.name: Faroe Islands - Werewolf Homeland
locations.description: Permanent homeland of all werewolves. Werewolves always resurrect here. Contains dungeons of all grades.
locations.lore: The Predator Duke sought this land to gain an infinite food source from werewolves who always resurrect here.

locations.name: Shetland Islands, Scotland
locations.description: The base of the Predator Duke.
locations.lore: The Duke sat on a very wide chair plotting to use the Werewolf Clan as bait for Lee Jiwon.

locations.name: King-Emperor's Tomb
locations.description: A major raid dungeon in East Asia. Contains a sacrifice mechanic and five random chests.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon volunteered as sacrifice and hinted to Song Haein to pick the fifth chest.

locations.name: 27th High-Grade Dungeon (Dark Caster Dungeon)
locations.description: A high-grade dungeon contested between the Shire Guild and Spencer Guild. Features the Dark Caster boss.
locations.lore: First cleared by Lee Jiwon's party. The Spencer Guild's subsequent failure was kept secret for months.

locations.name: Paju Hunting Grounds
locations.description: Area north of Seoul. Territory of giant spiders.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon hunted here immediately after waking from his four-year sleep.

locations.name: The Judge's Continent
locations.description: The next stage after Otadolon. A massive continent divided into sections. Earth's survivors in the Empire face off against 1.3 billion Crootian enemies. Golden rings replace stat points as the primary power currency.
locations.lore: The novel ends partway through this arc.

locations.name: Sea of Reset
locations.description: A black sea accessible via a ninety-degree cliff. Jumping into it resets all skills, stats, and inventory to zero.
dangers: Complete reset of all stats, skills, and inventory
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon jumped on April 15, 2034. Instead of spawning in Minnesota, he woke up on July 17, 2022 before the world even changed.

locations.name: Don Gate
locations.description: A gate enabling deva transformation when a token of knowledge is used. Disappears after each use and reappears at a random location.
dangers: Transformation process is extremely painful - 600 seconds
locations.lore: About 2 billion people had become devas after 10 years.

locations.name: Luna Hotel
locations.description: Front business and headquarters of the Hitman Guild in Seoul.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon visited to confront Oh Taeshik and extort 47 million golden rings.

locations.name: Ogre Dungeon, Section 35 (Judge's Continent)
locations.description: A high-grade dungeon at the westernmost point of Section 35 of the Judge's Continent. Triggered the Survival special event for Lee Jiwon.
dangers: Ogres - increasingly powerful during Survival event
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon spent over 30 days inside while Dunia waited outside unable to enter.

locations.name: Oksunbong Peak, Danyang
locations.description: Mountain in Chungcheong province where Low-grade Dungeon 83 is hidden.
locations.lore: Discovered by Lee Jiwon during his early nationwide dungeon-seeking tour.

locations.name: Baengrokdam, Jeju Island
locations.description: A volcanic crater lake on Jeju Island. Location of Mid-grade Dungeon 35.
locations.lore: Lee Jiwon found the entrance about 3km from where he initially expected.

realms_and_dimensions.name: Otadolon Stage
realms_and_dimensions.description: The game-like existence that Earth entered on July 17, 2023. Humans become devas, monsters appear, dungeons form. Ends when conditions are met and transitions to the Judge's Continent.
access_methods: Born into or surviving the world change
Using a token of knowledge at a Don Gate for deva transformation
realms_and_dimensions.lore: The Scientist explained less than 1% of what the Otadolon stage entailed.

realms_and_dimensions.name: The Judge's Continent
realms_and_dimensions.description: The stage after Otadolon. A massive continent divided into numbered sections. Earth's survivors in the Empire battle 1.3 billion Crootian enemies. Golden rings are the primary power currency.
access_methods: Being transported via the giant Don Gate leaderboard calculation
realms_and_dimensions.lore: The author planned further stages (Keeper of Terra, Mamon) which were scrapped.

factions.name: Sunbin Group / Sunbin Guild
factions.description: The largest and most powerful organisation in South Korea, controlling Seoul, Incheon, and Gyeonggi province. Operates thirty-seven first response commando teams.
factions.history: Built by Song Daechul during Otadolon chaos. Lee Jiwon was their greatest early benefactor.
factions.lore: One of only a few organisations that treated non-devas humanely.

factions.name: Myth Guild
factions.description: Egypt's most powerful deva organisation. Controls Cairo and multiple dungeons. Long-standing war with the Blood Prince's Federation.
factions.history: In original timeline lost to the Blood Prince and Egypt was destroyed. In current timeline Lee Jiwon's intervention turned the tide.
factions.lore: Shin made a strict guild rule: no member may stay inside a dungeon for more than one month.

factions.name: Cheng Long Guild
factions.description: China's foremost deva organisation. Led by Wai Chung.
factions.history: Conspired with Kazunari and Nayuta to imprison Lee Jiwon.

factions.name: Nayuta Guild
factions.description: Japan's leading deva organisation. Led by Okamoto.
factions.history: Participated in the prison dungeon conspiracy.

factions.name: Shire Group / Shire Guild
factions.description: America's largest and richest corporation-guild. Controls multiple high-grade dungeons. Led by Daniel Miller.
factions.history: Invited Lee Jiwon to help clear the 27th high-grade dungeon. Core pillar of the Empire.

factions.name: Messenger Guild
factions.description: The wealthiest guild in the world, operating the global Teleporter network. Led by Victor Lucas.
factions.history: Aligned with the Empire when news of the Judge's Continent spread.
factions.lore: Teleporter fee is 100,000 golden rings per trip.

factions.name: Hitman Guild
factions.description: Seoul's underground gangster organisation. Survived the Sunbin Guild's operations thanks to Song Haechang being their insider.
factions.history: Ordered to kidnap Lee Jiwon by Song Haechang. Lee Jiwon extorted 47 million golden rings from them.
factions.lore: Deliberately kept small to avoid Sunbin Guild attention.

factions.name: Gnosis Guild
factions.description: An information guild. Secretive and expensive to deal with.
factions.history: Mentioned as a resource for finding people without their knowledge.

factions.name: The Seven Monarchs
factions.description: The seven most powerful known deities on Earth. By the Judge's Continent era referred to as the Five Monarchs after two were defeated.
factions.history: In the original timeline grew largely unchecked. Lee Jiwon defeats three of them in the current timeline.
factions.lore: Deities cannot gain EXP from killing devas or other deities.

factions.name: The Federation
factions.description: The Blood Prince's military alliance in Egypt, opposed to the Myth Guild.
factions.history: Defeated in the current timeline when Lee Jiwon held off the Blood Prince.

factions.name: Van Agassi Werewolf Clan
factions.description: An 800-year-old clan based in the Faroe Islands. Members undergo irreversible werewolf transformation after becoming devas.
factions.history: Sought help from every major faction against the Predator Duke and was turned down by all. Lee Jiwon was their last hope.
factions.lore: Lodin van Agassi spent 800 years building connections that all refused to help.

factions.name: The Empire
factions.description: Earth's defence coalition on the Judge's Continent. Multi-guild alliance fighting the Crootians.
factions.history: Formed after the Otadolon stage ended.

factions.name: Crootian High Council
factions.description: The governing body of the Crootians, 1.3 billion strong. Led by Claudia, the Master of Time.
factions.history: Deployed Dunia as an infiltration asset against Earth's defenders.
factions.lore: The leaderboard hovering in the sky tracks battle progress.

factions.name: Yung Gong Group / Guild
factions.description: Busan-based corporation-guild. Treated non-devas as slaves. Frequently clashed with Sunbin.
factions.history: Controlled Busan. Lee Jiwon compared reasonable life under Sunbin to slave conditions under Yung Gong.

factions.name: Abu Dhabi Royal Family Guild
factions.description: UAE guild led by Baden al Nayan. Fought the emirate of Astes and the Reaper.
factions.history: Aligned with Lee Jiwon against the Reaper / Astes conflict.
factions.lore: UAE official papers are gilded with real gold.

factions.name: Spencer Guild
factions.description: A rival guild to the Shire Guild in the competition for the 27th high-grade dungeon.
factions.history: The Shire Guild kept its successful clear secret for months to watch the Spencer Guild fail.

factions.name: Store 72
factions.description: One of 108 game-world shops serving Earth's devas. Sells skills, items, and runs auction services.
factions.history: Jiwon's primary skill and item shop. Source of Unrivaled, Shaman Ko's Selfish Prick, and Judge's Gavel.

battles_and_events.name: The World Change - Otadolon Begins
battles_and_events.summary: On July 17, 2023 at 9 AM KST, the Scientist's voice echoed across the entire planet. All 6500 languages merged into Genenian. Every human received a token of knowledge. Earth transitioned into the Otadolon stage.
battles_and_events.outcome: Earth transforms into a game-like world
battles_and_events.significance: The inciting event for the entire novel.
lore_revealed: Earth is called World 1455 by the Scientist
The Scientist treats the world as a scientific experiment
All human languages unified into Genenian
Tokens of knowledge cannot be stolen or lost

battles_and_events.name: Lee Jiwon Becomes Earth's First Deva
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon used his token 2.1777 seconds after the world changed, breaking the previous fastest record of 3 hours 27 minutes. He received 200 bonus stat points, 10 bonus skill points, and won the Fastest Deva event choosing Luck Boost. He then learned Unrivaled at level 0.
battles_and_events.outcome: Lee Jiwon starts with 1220 in all stats, 20 skill points, Unrivaled, and permanent Luck Boost
battles_and_events.significance: Establishes Lee Jiwon's overwhelming head start.
lore_revealed: First deva gets 200 bonus stat points, not the rumoured 100
The Black Clawed Panther deliberately lied about the bonus amount
Unrivaled skill exists hidden in Store 72's general catalogue for 20 skill points

battles_and_events.name: First Boss Defeat - Legendary Red Orc Champion
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon cleared the three-floor Bukhansan Mountain dungeon solo at level 15 and defeated the four-man recommended boss solo.
battles_and_events.outcome: First dungeon boss ever killed in the current timeline. Obtained Rank 3 greatsword and Rank 2 armor.
battles_and_events.significance: Validates his stat advantage and dungeon-seeking strategy.
lore_revealed: Boss raids scale stats per extra party member above minimum

battles_and_events.name: Battle of Egypt - The Blood Prince Confrontation
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon holds off the Blood Prince for over an hour during the decisive battle between the Myth Guild and the Federation. He survives Blood Rush under Blood Rain and gives the Myth Guild the three-second window they need.
battles_and_events.outcome: Myth Guild victory. Blood Purge that destroyed Egypt in the original timeline is prevented.
battles_and_events.significance: First major world-altering event diverging from the original timeline.
lore_revealed: Blood Rush doubles all blood skill effects
Unrivaled reduces deity damage by 50%

battles_and_events.name: King-Emperor's Tomb Raid
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon volunteers as sacrifice for the King-Emperor's Tomb raid. He signals Song Haein to pick the fifth chest from which she receives a Rank 9 item. Lee Jiwon also obtains the King-Emperor's Commitment.
battles_and_events.outcome: Song Haein obtains Rank 9 item. Lee Jiwon receives King-Emperor's Commitment and 1.3 billion golden rings.
battles_and_events.significance: Major item acquisition. Deepens Sunbin-Lee Jiwon alliance.
lore_revealed: Sacrifice mechanic in raids
Rank 9 items exist and are exceptionally rare

battles_and_events.name: Battle Against the Predator Duke
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon intervenes to save the Werewolf Clan from the Predator Duke. Shaman Ko manifests and consumes the Predation ability from the Duke, saving Jiwon and giving him a Scroll of Predation.
battles_and_events.outcome: Predator Duke defeated. Werewolf Clan saved. Scroll of Predation obtained.
battles_and_events.significance: Second Monarch defeated. Shaman Ko's true nature first revealed.
lore_revealed: Killing the Predator Duke once restores all stolen abilities
Shaman Ko can physically manifest and consume abilities from defeated targets

battles_and_events.name: Kazunari's Prison Dungeon Trap
battles_and_events.summary: Wai Chung, Okamoto, and Kazunari conspire to trap Lee Jiwon in a purpose-built prison dungeon with no food, water, or escape. Lee Jiwon eventually escapes.
battles_and_events.outcome: Lee Jiwon escapes. Enormous resources spent by Cheng Long and Nayuta are wasted.
battles_and_events.significance: Reveals depth of the conspiracy against Lee Jiwon.
lore_revealed: Custom dungeons can be built with the Dungeon Maker's ability

battles_and_events.name: Battle of Abu Dhabi - The Reaper
battles_and_events.summary: The Reaper activates a Target skill cancelling Unrivaled and threatening 10 deity death penalties on Lee Jiwon's death. After two near-deaths (both saved by Bracelet of Eternal Fire), Lee Jiwon uses Predation on Shaman Ko (Effect 2) to multiply all stats tenfold and overwhelms the Reaper.
battles_and_events.outcome: Reaper defeated. Baden al Nayan's guild and Abu Dhabi saved.
battles_and_events.significance: Third Monarch defeated. Shaman Ko consumed by Jiwon - the pinnacle of the story's power ceiling.
lore_revealed: The Reaper's Target skill cancels Unrivaled
Consuming Shaman Ko via Predation grants tenfold stat boost

battles_and_events.name: 27th High-Grade Dungeon - Dark Caster Raid
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon joins the Shire Guild's party, identifies the Dark Crystal fail-safe in the Dark Caster boss, and clears the dungeon. Samuel gives him all 20 random chests. The 20th yields the Dark Crystal (Rank 8).
battles_and_events.outcome: Dungeon cleared. Dark Crystal (Rank 8) obtained. Shire Guild alliance formed.
lore_revealed: High-grade dungeon bosses can have hidden fail-safe mechanics

battles_and_events.name: Duel - Lee Jiwon vs Arthur Lucas
battles_and_events.summary: Arthur Lucas challenges Lee Jiwon to test his heroic credentials. Arthur spends over 400 million golden rings but Lee Jiwon wins. Arthur is registered in Call. Victor Lucas aligns Messenger Guild with the Empire.
battles_and_events.outcome: Lee Jiwon wins decisively. Messenger Guild joins Empire coalition.
battles_and_events.significance: Arthur Lucas revealed stronger than any Monarch. Messenger Guild aligned with Empire.
lore_revealed: House Centipede system fully explained

battles_and_events.name: Survival Event - Ogre Dungeon, Judge's Continent
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon enters an empty Ogre Dungeon on the Judge's Continent and triggers a Survival event. All 1674 devas inside are ejected, monsters grow stronger over time. Lee Jiwon spends over 30 days inside.
battles_and_events.outcome: Lee Jiwon completes 30+ days in the Survival event while Dunia waits outside unable to enter.
battles_and_events.significance: Demonstrates Lee Jiwon's dominance on the Judge's Continent. Introduces Dunia's curiosity.
lore_revealed: Judge's Continent dungeons yield poor EXP vs Earth dungeons
Special events can be triggered by reaching power thresholds

battles_and_events.name: Sunbin Group Job Interview
battles_and_events.summary: Lee Jiwon applies for a Sunbin Group job with only a high school diploma but six letters of recommendation from Daniel Miller, Baden al Nayan, and other world leaders. HR nearly rejects it until Kim Jongmin confirms the letters are genuine.
battles_and_events.outcome: Novel ends before the interview decision. Lee Jiwon sits as interviewee number 115.
battles_and_events.significance: The novel's final arc showing the world's most powerful deva applying for an entry-level office job.
lore_revealed: Post-Otadolon Earth returned to normal society
Lee Jiwon's reputation extends to presidents and guild masters of major world powers

arcs.title: Regression and Preparation Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon jumps into the Sea of Reset and wakes up in July 2022, one year before the world changes. He plans meticulously and on July 17, 2023 becomes Earth's First Deva with maximum possible bonuses.
arcs.power_level_context: Level 0 with 1220 all stats at arc end

arcs.title: Dungeon Discovery Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon systematically discovers all dungeons across South Korea, clears the first boss solo, and Song Haein begins tracking him.

arcs.title: Four-Year Sleep Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon falls asleep for four years. Wakes to Song Haechang insulting him. The Hitman Guild is ordered to kidnap him.
arcs.power_level_context: Woke at level 32 with 4488 unspent stat points

arcs.title: Gorgon Hunting and Levelling Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon hunts Gorgons in Pocheon for two weeks gaining 100 levels. Acquires Medusa's Cursed Earrings. Deals with the Hitman Guild.
major_gains: 47 million golden rings from Hitman Guild

arcs.title: Egypt and Myth Guild Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon allies with the Myth Guild, helps them defeat the Blood Prince's Federation, then grinds Egypt's dungeons to reach level 450.

arcs.title: Sunbin Reconciliation and King-Emperor's Tomb Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon returns to Korea, confronts Oh Taeshik, meets Song Haechang, participates in the King-Emperor's Tomb raid, and reconciles with Song Daechul.

arcs.title: Werewolf Clan and Predator Duke Arc
arcs.summary: Kylie van Agassi finds Lee Jiwon and begs for help against the Predator Duke. Lee Jiwon defeats the Duke with Shaman Ko's intervention.

arcs.title: Shire Guild and Dark Caster Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon joins the Shire Guild's raid, identifies the Dark Crystal fail-safe, clears the dungeon, and receives the Dark Crystal from the 20th random chest.

arcs.title: Kazunari Prison Dungeon Arc
arcs.summary: Kazunari, Wai Chung, and Okamoto trap Lee Jiwon in a purpose-built prison dungeon. Lee Jiwon escapes.

arcs.title: Reaper Battle - Abu Dhabi Arc
arcs.summary: The Reaper deploys his Target skill against Lee Jiwon. After two near-deaths using the Bracelet of Eternal Fire, Lee Jiwon uses Predation on Shaman Ko to multiply all stats tenfold and overwhelm the Reaper.

arcs.title: Arthur Lucas - House Centipede Arc
arcs.summary: Arthur Lucas challenges Lee Jiwon to test his heroic credentials. Lee Jiwon wins and registers Arthur in Call. Victor Lucas aligns the Messenger Guild with the Empire.

arcs.title: Judge's Continent Arc
arcs.summary: After Otadolon ends, Lee Jiwon leads the Empire against the Crootians, survives the Ogre Dungeon Survival event, encounters Dunia, and deals with Zulova.

arcs.title: Return to Earth Arc
arcs.summary: Lee Jiwon returns to his rooftop apartment, decides to move, and applies for a job at the Sunbin Group with letters of recommendation from world leaders.
major_gains: Shaman Ko speaks for the first time

prophecies_and_lore.title: The Scientist's Announcement
prophecies_and_lore.content: Ah! Ah! Can you hear me? The test is over. World 1455's test has completed. You will enter the Otadolon stage. All languages will be replaced by Genenian. Childbirth is prohibited. You may obtain immortality via the token of knowledge at a Don Gate. The Don Gate can only be used once by adults 19 or older. You will have to find the Don Gate yourselves.
prophecies_and_lore.significance: The foundational lore event of the entire novel. Less than 1% of the Otadolon stage's rules were explained.

prophecies_and_lore.title: Who Will Be the Fastest Deva of All Event
prophecies_and_lore.content: Find the person holding the record of the fastest deva transformation. Only one winner. Current first place: 3 hours 27 minutes 41.9755 seconds. Lee Jiwon's record: 2.1777 seconds.
prophecies_and_lore.significance: Lee Jiwon's 2.1777-second transformation set an effectively unbreakable record. His Luck Boost means he is always the luckiest person on Earth.

prophecies_and_lore.title: The Judge's Continent - Next Stage
prophecies_and_lore.content: The Otadolon stage has ended. Earth's survivors are being transported to the Judge's Continent. Golden rings are power here. 1.3 billion enemies await.
prophecies_and_lore.significance: The novel ends mid-way through this stage.

prophecies_and_lore.title: The Mystery of Lee Jiwon's Veiled Information
prophecies_and_lore.content: Dunia's ability to know things is blocked entirely when he tries to investigate Lee Jiwon. He cannot learn Lee Jiwon's level, items, skills, age, or any personal information. Only indirect information like location is accessible.
prophecies_and_lore.significance: Implies Lee Jiwon's regressed nature or Shaman Ko's presence creates a veil that no information ability can penetrate. Never fully explained.

terminology.definition: The game-like stage Earth entered after the Scientist's announcement. Monsters, dungeons, and golden rings appear. Humans can become devas. Ends when conditions are met, transitioning to the Judge's Continent.

A human who has used a token of knowledge at a Don Gate and been transformed into an immortal game-avatar body. Has stat menus, skill trees, inventory systems, and level progressions. Resurrects after death with stat penalties.
A superior existence above devas. Cannot gain EXP from killing devas and devas cannot gain EXP from killing deities. Appear to have been chosen rather than earned through levelling.
A silvery card-like tattoo that appeared on every human's wrist at the world change. Cannot be stolen, lost, or transferred. Usable only at a Don Gate by adults aged 19 or older.
A gate enabling deva transformation when a token of knowledge is used. Disappears after each use and reappears at a random location. Transformation takes 600 seconds and is extremely painful.
A black sea accessible via a cliff. Jumping into it resets all skills, stats, and inventory to zero. Lee Jiwon's jump instead sent him back in time to before the world changed.
The universal language imposed on all of humanity at the start of Otadolon. All 6500 human languages were replaced. Every human can speak, read, and write it as a mother tongue.
When a deva loses all HP, they respawn with -2 points to every stat (10 total). Recovery items exist but are extremely rare and expensive.
A special passive Lee Jiwon obtained. Grants bonus stat points for each dungeon discovered. Low-grade: 1 point, Mid-grade: 2 points, High-grade: 3 points. Reward every 10 points.
The seven most powerful known deities on Earth. By the Judge's Continent era referred to as the Five Monarchs after two were defeated.
A temporary blessing granted after clearing a dungeon boss. While active, the blessed deva cannot enter any dungeon.

A hidden stat not shown on the stat menu. Higher luck leads to more critical hits, better drops, and higher rank items from random chests. Lee Jiwon's Luck Boost keeps him permanently one point above the luckiest person on Earth.
The universal currency of Otadolon and Judge's Continent stages. Dropped by monsters and found in dungeons. On the Judge's Continent can be spent to directly boost combat stats.
A system allowing a deva to register a target and then call them at will, forcing them to appear. Lee Jiwon uses this to maintain leverage over Zulova and Arthur Lucas.
The being who announced the world change. Called God initially but renamed the Scientist because he referred to the world as a test. Never appears directly.
A weapon stat bypassing a portion of the target's physical defense. The Orc Champion's Greatsword had Penetration +47, making it worth more than its Rank 3 classification suggested.
A stat rising with activity and limiting combat effectiveness. Warrior's Brave Spirit prevents fatigue rise while active.

character_analyses.fighting_style: Aggressive high-damage melee spearman who uses superior stats to overwhelm opponents rather than technique. Strategy is simple: attack relentlessly with the spear while trusting his HP pool and DEF to absorb hits. He does not use complex feints unless absolutely necessary. Against Monarchs, he times AoE skills, keeps pressure with basic attacks, and saves finishing moves for decisive moments. He relies heavily on equipment passive effects rather than active defensive skills.

move_breakdown.description: Guaranteed critical hit with 500% base damage multiplier and 1000% CRIT damage. Sent the Reaper flying ten meters back.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Reserved for decisive high-damage moments. Used on cooldown against the Reaper.

move_breakdown.description: Activation buff raising ATT 20%, CRIT 1%, CRIT damage 50%, movement speed 5%, attack speed 2.5%.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Used when entering sustained combat against a Monarch.

move_breakdown.description: Uses Scroll of Predation to consume Shaman Ko (Effect 2), multiplying all non-Shaman-Ko stats tenfold for 24 hours. HP jumps from near-zero to over 67 million.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Used only when all other options were exhausted and death was literally one blow away.

move_breakdown.description: Ground-rupturing AoE attack forcing opponents to respond to area damage.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Against opponents who match in direct combat. Also for clearing large monster groups.

move_breakdown.description: Short-range teleport. Almost never used in normal combat; saved as an ace card for critical moments.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Held in reserve for critical decisive moments.

strategic_tendencies: Preserves trump cards (Blink, Judge's Gavel) until the most decisive moment
Reads fight flow analytically even while taking massive damage
Uses equipment passives as consistent damage reduction rather than active dodging
Taunts opponents to provoke mistakes and emotional responses
Relies on Bracelet of Eternal Fire as an insurance safety net
Scouts bosses with prior knowledge from future memory whenever possible
Hunts alone to maximise EXP per kill
character_analyses.power_scaling_notes: Level 0 with 1220 all stats (equivalent to level 600 average deva) to level 195 after Gorgon hunting, level 450 after three months in Egypt, level 690 during Reaper battle. The Predation of Shaman Ko represents the ceiling: 235,740 STR, 147,010 AGI, 149,010 VIT for 24 hours.
character_analyses.character_arc_analysis: Lee Jiwon begins as a cynical, desperate man gambling everything on a time-regression miracle. His initial motivation is revenge and self-preservation. Over the novel, his obsessive greed evolves into genuine purpose. He stops fighting only for himself and becomes the de facto hero of Earth despite never seeking the title. His relationship with Song Haein is the emotional anchor of his maturation. At the novel's end, the world's most powerful being is applying for an entry-level office job - a final punchline that underlines how much he values normalcy after thirty years of conflict.
character_analyses.role_in_world: The lynchpin of Earth's survival. By preventing the Blood Purge in Egypt, the Werewolf Clan's extinction, and the Reaper's victory in the UAE, Lee Jiwon reshapes the entire geopolitical landscape of the Otadolon stage.

character_analyses.fighting_style: Overwhelming area denial through blood-element powers. Uses rain and wave attacks to control terrain and drain opponent HP continuously. Blood Rush doubles all effects. Underestimates opponents by talking too much and reacting emotionally to effective resistance.

move_breakdown.description: Creates a torrential blood rain covering a large area dealing continuous damage. Under Blood Rush becomes a true typhoon.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Deployed as field control to wear down opponents over time.

move_breakdown.description: Power-up mode doubling all blood skill effects. Activated only when genuinely threatened.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Activated against Lee Jiwon after being held at stalemate longer than expected.

strategic_tendencies: Area denial via Blood Rain before direct engagement
Uses Blood Rush only when threatened
Threatens to attack allies to force a reaction
character_analyses.power_scaling_notes: Seven Monarchs tier. Under Blood Rush, effectively doubles all output. In the original timeline won every engagement with the Myth Guild until Lee Jiwon intervened.
character_analyses.character_arc_analysis: The Blood Prince exists as Lee Jiwon's first major test. He is presented as genuinely terrifying but emotionally predictable - his anger and arrogance are exploitable.
character_analyses.role_in_world: The primary threat to Egypt in both timelines. His defeat represents the first major butterfly effect of Lee Jiwon's return.

character_analyses.fighting_style: Pay-to-win melee fighter using the House Centipede system to spend golden rings on every exchange. Fights similarly to Lee Jiwon - aggressive and direct. Has enough base power to outlast a Monarch. Weakness: the per-use cap cannot infinitely scale.

move_breakdown.description: A powerful charge attack boosted by golden ring investment on activation.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Primary offensive attack throughout the duel.

move_breakdown.description: Manifests a powerful shield boosted by golden ring investment. Even with 700% DEF boost still took 15 million damage from Lee Jiwon's critical hits.
move_breakdown.conditions_used: Defensive counter when Lee Jiwon pushed hard.

strategic_tendencies: Boost attack and defense on every exchange using golden rings
Maintain Combat Mode for sustained power boosts
character_analyses.power_scaling_notes: Explicitly stated by Lee Jiwon as stronger than any Monarch. Spent over 400 million golden rings and still lost.
character_analyses.character_arc_analysis: Arthur arrives as an apparent antagonist but is immediately humanised - a childlike boy crying to his father after losing a fight. His desire to be a hero is naive but sincere. His arc in two chapters moves from threat to potential ally.
character_analyses.role_in_world: His father's alignment with the Empire brings the Messenger Guild's global Teleporter network into Earth's defence coalition.

power_rankings.title: Top 10 Strongest at Novel End (Otadolon Stage Peak)
power_rankings.methodology: Based on demonstrated combat performance, item quality, skill power, and narrative positioning.

entries.peak_power: Level 690 with Predation of Shaman Ko: 235,740 STR, 147,010 AGI, 149,010 VIT
entries.reasoning: The only person to defeat three Monarchs. Under Predation of Shaman Ko his stats dwarf everyone in the novel.

entries.peak_power: Base power stronger than any of the Seven Monarchs
entries.reasoning: Explicitly stated by Lee Jiwon to be stronger than a Monarch. Spent over 400 million golden rings and kept fighting. Lost only when the per-use cap limited his scaling.

entries.peak_power: Seven Monarchs tier Deity with Target skill that cancels Unrivaled
entries.reasoning: Required Lee Jiwon to use his single-use Predation of Shaman Ko to defeat. Was winning for over an hour with Lee Jiwon near death.

entries.peak_power: Seven Monarchs tier Deity with unlimited ability absorption
entries.reasoning: Theoretically the strongest Monarch if allowed to grow unchecked.

entries.peak_power: Seven Monarchs tier Deity with Blood Rush
entries.reasoning: Overwhelmed the entire Myth Guild and Lee Jiwon simultaneously under Blood Rush.
Froze Dunia in statue form for five years. No Crootian deity challenges her openly. Time manipulation is the most conceptually powerful ability in the novel.
A Monarch but never shown in direct combat. His prison dungeon required 2000 devas to sacrifice themselves and still failed.
Guild master of Egypt's most powerful guild. Acknowledges being vastly below Monarchs and Lee Jiwon.
Described as being at a level beyond normal devas. Became Lee Jiwon's involuntary ally.

entries.peak_power: First Unrivaled deva of the Sunbin Guild
entries.reasoning: In his prime would have been among the strongest Korean devas.

relationship_dynamics.analysis: A slow-burn relationship built on professional respect and mutual intrigue. Song Haein is drawn to Lee Jiwon's inexplicable confidence. Lee Jiwon keeps his emotional distance due to his lone-wolf instincts. The relationship serves as Lee Jiwon's primary anchor to normalcy and human connection.
relationship_dynamics.thematic_significance: Represents Lee Jiwon's gradual re-integration into human society after eleven years of isolation.

relationship_dynamics.analysis: A one-sided antagonistic relationship. Song Haechang fixates on Lee Jiwon as a proxy enemy for all his failures. Lee Jiwon barely thinks about Haechang. When they finally meet, Jiwon's indifference is more devastating than any violence.
relationship_dynamics.thematic_significance: Explores the toxicity of unchecked inferiority complex and how external success cannot compensate for internal inadequacy.

relationship_dynamics.analysis: A professional alliance built on mutual benefit that deepens into genuine friendship. Shin is one of the few characters who accepts Lee Jiwon unconditionally. She risks her guild's entire future on a deva she barely knows.
relationship_dynamics.thematic_significance: Represents the possibility of forging genuine connections even in a world of strategic alliances.

relationship_dynamics.analysis: The most mysterious relationship in the novel. Shaman Ko exists as both Lee Jiwon's good luck charm and a literal child who appears at his most desperate moments. Lee Jiwon barely acknowledges him until the Reaper battle. Their final exchange about moving house suggests a genuine bond.
relationship_dynamics.thematic_significance: Shaman Ko personifies luck and fate. Lee Jiwon's refusal to analyse him mirrors his broader relationship with his improbable second chance.

foreshadowing_analysis.hint: The first deva's bonus was rumoured to be 100 stat points but Lee Jiwon is suspicious of the Black Clawed Panther's secrecy
foreshadowing_analysis.payoff: The actual bonus is 200 stat points. The Panther deliberately suppressed the truth to prevent competitors.

foreshadowing_analysis.hint: Lee Jiwon chose Option 5 (Luck Boost) because luck provides advantages that compound invisibly over time
foreshadowing_analysis.payoff: Luck Boost causes the daily Shaman Ko roulette to always land on 3, critical hits at abnormal frequency, and the 20th random chest out of 20 being the only one to contain a real item.

foreshadowing_analysis.hint: Shaman Ko's Will description hints at a physical manifestation - reacts to powerful desire
foreshadowing_analysis.payoff: Shaman Ko physically manifests during the Predator Duke battle and consumes the Predation ability. Is then consumed by Lee Jiwon during the Reaper battle for a tenfold stat boost.

foreshadowing_analysis.hint: Dunia cannot find any information about Lee Jiwon despite being able to find indirect information about anyone else
foreshadowing_analysis.payoff: Never explicitly resolved - implies Jiwon's regressed nature or Shaman Ko's presence creates a veil that no information ability can penetrate.

plot_patterns.pattern: The Lone Genius Rule - Lee Jiwon refuses help until the stakes exceed solo capability
plot_patterns.analysis: Every major alliance follows the same arc: Lee Jiwon is reluctant, the partner is desperate, and the alliance forms around mutual benefit. Used effectively to keep Lee Jiwon independent-feeling even as his circle grows.

plot_patterns.pattern: The Overpowered Safety Net - a specific trump card saved exclusively for a seemingly unwinnable moment
occurrences: Bracelet of Eternal Fire in Blood Prince battle
Bracelet AND Predation of Shaman Ko in Reaper battle
plot_patterns.analysis: Each successive Monarch battle escalates by consuming one more layer of safety nets. Effective at maintaining tension but the pattern becomes visible by the third use.

plot_patterns.pattern: The Extortion Pattern - Lee Jiwon defeats an antagonist and then extorts them into becoming a resource or ally
occurrences: Zulova (100 million golden rings plus Diamond Class scheme)
plot_patterns.analysis: Used as comedic relief after intense battles. Shows Lee Jiwon's pragmatic and slightly petty nature.

plot_patterns.pattern: The World-Save-Through-Selfishness - Lee Jiwon's self-interested decisions accidentally save large populations
occurrences: Werewolf Clan assistance stops Duke's growth
plot_patterns.analysis: The novel's central irony. Lee Jiwon repeatedly saves the world not out of altruism but because the same enemies threaten both him and others. This makes him a more believable hero than a purely selfless one.

world_building_insights.insight: The game mechanics are real physics in this world - death penalties, stat points, and skill cooldowns are absolute universal rules, not abstractions
evidence: Death penalty gems exist and can be collected
Fatigue has physical symptoms matching the numerical stat
HP regeneration from Lush Greenery is felt as actual healing
world_building_insights.significance: Unlike most isekai novels, the game mechanics have weight and consequence. The 10 deity death penalties threat during the Reaper battle is existential rather than mechanical.

world_building_insights.insight: The power gap between devas and deities is not just numerical but categorical - killing a deity yields no benefit to a deva
evidence: Deities cannot gain EXP from killing devas
Devas cannot gain EXP from killing deities
Deities view devas as toe jam or servants at best
world_building_insights.significance: Creates a natural class separation that the Seven Monarchs exploit. Lee Jiwon fighting Monarchs is inherently unprofitable for him in game terms.

world_building_insights.insight: The Scientist treats humanity with casual indifference rather than malice or benevolence - it is truly a scientific experiment
evidence: Less than 1% of world rules were explained
You will have to figure out the rest yourselves
Don Gates appear at random with no guidance
world_building_insights.significance: The horror of the world change is depersonalised - there is no villain behind the system, just scientific process.

central_themes: Second chances are only as valuable as the person given them - advantage without growth is squandered
Greed properly channelled can be the fuel for heroism rather than its opposite
The cost of survival in a changed world falls disproportionately on those without power
Authentic human connection is harder to build in a game world but more precious for its difficulty
The absurdity of applying RPG logic to genuine human suffering
motifs: The Sea of Reset - irreversible action and the possibility of escape from one's mistakes
Food and eating - Lee Jiwon's obsessive eating is his clearest expression of joy celebrating his second life
Death penalties - the specific quantification of failure and the cost of mistakes
The lone figure standing against a Monarch - the novel's recurring visual image
Rooftop room - Lee Jiwon's origin point and psychological anchor, eventually outgrown
thematic_analysis.author_message: The World Turned into a Game After I Woke Up uses the regression-to-game-world premise to explore a fundamentally optimistic thesis: that a person's second chance matters less than what they choose to do with it. Lee Jiwon does not succeed because he went back in time - he succeeds because his eleven years of failure gave him wisdom, resilience, and the capacity to build genuine alliances. The novel is also a quiet argument against fatalism: by preventing the Blood Purge, the Duke's conquest, and the Reaper's victory, Lee Jiwon demonstrates that the future is not fixed even for a regressor with complete future knowledge.

unanswered_questions.question: Why did the Sea of Reset send Lee Jiwon back in time to before the world changed instead of to the Minnesota spawn point?
unanswered_questions.context: Established in Ch. 1-2 as the central mystery. Lee Jiwon himself cannot explain it.
theories: His prayer to God was heard and a miracle occurred
The Scientist deliberately selected him for a second run of the test
Shaman Ko's connection to him existed before deva transformation and influenced the reset outcome
World 1455 has a unique property allowing temporal regression under specific emotional conditions

unanswered_questions.question: Why is all personal information about Lee Jiwon hidden from Dunia's information ability?
unanswered_questions.context: Established in Ch. 264 - Dunia can find indirect info (location) but zero direct info about Lee Jiwon.
theories: Jiwon's status as a regressor creates an anomaly information abilities cannot categorise
Shaman Ko's existence as his passive skill creates a protective veil
The Scientist is deliberately hiding Lee Jiwon from information-type abilities

unanswered_questions.question: What is the full nature of Shaman Ko - a conscious entity, a fragment of the game system, or something else?
unanswered_questions.context: Shaman Ko's first words appear in Ch. 299 asking about moving house. He has a physical body and can consent to being consumed.
theories: Shaman Ko is the personification of Lee Jiwon's luck stat
Shaman Ko is a unique entity created when Lee Jiwon chose Option 5 (Luck Boost)
Shaman Ko is a fragment of the Scientist's monitoring system

unanswered_questions.question: Who is Lee Gangchan and what exactly did he do to Lee Jiwon in the original timeline?
unanswered_questions.context: Referenced as the person who drove Lee Jiwon to jump into the Sea of Reset. Killed Jiwon over 100 times.
theories: A more powerful deva who targeted Lee Jiwon out of guild conflict or personal rivalry
Someone Lee Jiwon trusted who betrayed him
A hunter hired by a powerful guild to eliminate Lee Jiwon

unanswered_questions.question: What are the full rules and stakes of the Judge's Continent - does losing mean Earth is destroyed?
unanswered_questions.context: Partially established in Ch. 250+. The Crootians and Earth's defenders fight but the ultimate consequence of losing is never clearly defined.
theories: Losing means Earth becomes a permanent Crootian territory
It is another test by the Scientist with no permanent death - just relegation
Losing means full planetary extinction for Earth's survivors
